integrity: The bijection, matching argument and forest recursion are proved within the accompanying result; no claim of publication priority, authorship, or independent certification is made.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite simple undirected graphs with every edge subdivided exactly once; not selective or multiple subdivision.
For general base graphs the vertex-subset formula is finite but may be exponential to evaluate; the polynomial-time recursion is proved only for forest bases.
Computations are finite consistency checks, not a replacement for the universal combinatorial proof.
A conflicting published family-specific ladder formula and residual risk of an equivalent earlier formulation are documented in the scientific review.
title: Independent-domination polynomial and induced matchings of once-subdivided graphs
